mapper.select: select t.id, t.bg_color as bgColor, t.bg_image_file_id as bgImageFileId, t.mobile_bg_image_file_id as mobileBgImageFileId, t.bg_display as bgDisplay, t.colors_json as colorsJson, t.theme_status as themeStatus, t.version_no as versionNo from basket_site_theme_binding b join basket_site_theme t on t.id = b.theme_id and t.is_delete = 0 and t.theme_status = 1 where b.is_delete = 0 and b.scope_type = #{scopeType} and b.scope_id = #{scopeId} limit 1
